bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 East Lothian - Saving the Musselburgh Carriage Will Kirk and Kirsten Ramsay head to Musselburgh, on Scotland's east coast. It's a town boasting a proud heritage that is celebrated each year with a procession led by their elected Honest Lad and Honest Lass. However, for the past few years, the antique carriage these local luminaries ride in has been off the road. Restoring the carriage is a huge job that requires the skills of local signwriter Ross Hastie and wheelwright Greg Rowland, and made more complicated by the impending deadline of this year's festival. A musical instrument also needs some tender loving care and Will gets a makeover at Scotland's oldest bespoke tailors.

cbsaustin.us.title: The Price Is Right
cbsaustin.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

Hosted by comic/singer/actor Wayne Brady, contestants -- often dressed in a wide variety of original costumes -- will still compete for money and prizes by striking wacky deals. Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. cinemax.us.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
cinemax.us.description: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman.

cinemax.us.title: The East
cinemax.us.description: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji.

cinemax.us.title: Black Butterfly
cinemax.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (movie) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: My Blind Brother
cinemax.us.description: Bill has always lived in the shadow of his overachieving brother Robbie, an arrogant athlete and local celebrity who happens to be blind. After years of thanklessly helping Robbie achieve one goal after another, Bill finally catches a break when he finds a connection with the charming Rose, who is dealing with her own crisis. But when Rose starts dating Robbie, Bill must decide if he can finally put his own happiness over his brother's and compete for the ultimate prize. (movie) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Judy
cinemax.us.description: Thirty years after starring in "The Wizard of Oz," beloved actress and singer Judy Garland arrives in London to perform sold-out shows at the Talk of the Town nightclub. While there, she reminisces with friends and fans and begins a whirlwind romance with musician Mickey Deans, her soon-to-be fifth husband. (movie) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Man Down
cinemax.us.description: When U.S. Marine Gabriel Drummer (Shia LaBeouf) returns from Afghanistan, he finds the place he once called home is no better than the battlefields he fought on overseas. Accompanied by his best friend, a hard-nosed Marine whose natural instinct is to shoot first and ask questions later, Gabriel searches desperately for his estranged son and his wife, leading to a suspect who has vital information about their location. (movie) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: Grudge Match
cinemax.us.description: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all. (movie) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: The Judge
cinemax.us.description: Hank Palmer (Robert Downey Jr.), a brilliant but shady attorney, returns to his Indiana hometown after learning that his mother has passed away. His arrival triggers renewed tension between himself and his father, Judge Joseph Palmer (Robert Duvall), who makes no secret of his disapproval of Hank's morally ambiguous career. As the lawyer prepares to depart, his father is arrested for a hit-and-run death. Hank takes on his father's defense, despite the objections of the resentful old man. (movie) - 2014

cinemaxaction.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
cinemaxaction.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition.

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Player
cinemaxaction.us.description: Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Gigan
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla and Anguirus fight three-headed dragon Ghidorah and huge bird Gigan at a cartoonist's theme park.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Hedorah
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla fights pollution in the form of living sludge found by a scientist (Akira Yamauchi) and his son (Toshie Kimura). (movie) - 1971

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Megalon
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla and flying cyborg Jet Jaguar meet a giant cockroach and a big black chicken sent by Seatopians. (movie) - 1973

cinemaxaction.us.title: Mom and Dad Save the World
cinemaxaction.us.description: While planning to destroy Earth with a gigantic laser beam, Emperor Tod Spengo (Jon Lovitz), ruler of the planet Spengo, catches a glimpse of housewife Marge Nelson (Teri Garr) and becomes smitten with her. Beaming Marge and her husband, Dick (Jeffrey Jones), up to Spengo from California, the daft, dimwitted leader tries to woo her, and sends her spouse to prison. Soon Dick is plotting an insurgency, in hopes of overthrowing Spengo and rescuing his wife. (movie) - 1992

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Usual Suspects
cinemaxaction.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (movie) - 1995

cinemaxaction.us.title: Trance
cinemaxaction.us.description: Simon (James McAvoy), a fine-art auctioneer, joins a gang of thieves led by Franck (Vincent Cassel) to steal a priceless Goya painting. During the heist Simon suffers a head injury and awakes with no memory of where he hid the artwork. When torture and physical threats fail to break through his amnesia, Franck hires a hypnotherapist named Elizabeth (Rosario Dawson) to find the answer. But as Elizabeth probes the recesses of Simon's mind, the lines between truth and deceit start to blur. (movie) - 2013

cinemaxaction.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
cinemaxaction.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (movie) - 2014

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
cinemaxclassics.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
cinemaxclassics.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Collision Course
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Detroit crime boss Madras hires men to smuggle a top secret, Japanese-made turbocharger into the U.S. But Madras' crooks are murdered, and the turbocharger goes missing. As he searches for the stolen engine, so does straitlaced Tokyo detective Fujitsuka Natsuo. Eventually, local authorities catch wind of the case, and onto the investigation comes brash cop Tony Costas, who must team with his polar opposite, Natsuo, to find the turbocharger.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Gimme Shelter
cinemaxclassics.us.description: The landmark documentary about the tragically ill-fated Rolling Stones free concert at Altamont Speedway on December 6, 1969. Only four months earlier, Woodstock defined the Love Generation; now it lay in ruins on a desolate racetrack six miles outside of San Francisco. (movie) - 1970

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Player
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood. (movie) - 1992

cinemaxclassics.us.title: It
cinemaxclassics.us.description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown. (movie) - 1990

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Hitcher
cinemaxclassics.us.description: While transporting a car from Chicago to San Diego, Jim Halsey (C. Thomas Howell) picks up a hitchhiker named John Ryder (Rutger Hauer), who claims to be a serial killer. After a daring escape, Jim hopes to never see Ryder again. But when he witnesses the hitchhiker murdering an entire family, Jim pursues Ryder with the help of truck-stop waitress Nash (Jennifer Jason Leigh), pitting the rivals against each other in a deadly series of car chases and brutal murders. (movie) - 1986

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Ghost Dog (Forest Whitaker) is a contract killer, a master of his trade who can whirl a gun at warp speed and moves through this world like a phantom -- stealthy and evanescent. In the spirit of the samurai, he has pledged his loyalty to a small time mobster named Louie (John Tormey) who saved his life many years before. (movie) - 1999

cinemaxhits.us.title: Inconceivable
cinemaxhits.us.description: Angela develops a friendship with a mysterious woman named Katie and offers her a job as a live-in nanny. The natural bond soon turns into a dangerous obsession as Katie becomes overly attached to the family's young daughter. Enduring lies and manipulations, Angela and her husband realize that sweet Katie is actually trying to destroy their family from within.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Girls Trip
cinemaxhits.us.description: Best friends Ryan, Sasha, Lisa and Dina are in for the adventure of a lifetime when they travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush.

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Internship
cinemaxhits.us.description: After old-school salesmen Billy and Nick find themselves downsized, Billy decides that, despite their complete lack of technological savvy, they should work for Google. The friends somehow manage to finagle internships at the Internet giant and promptly head out to Silicon Valley. Viewed with disdain by most of their fellow interns, Billy and Nick join forces with the rest of the misfit "nooglers" to make it through a series of competitive team challenges.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Ocean's 11
cinemaxhits.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemaxhits.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemaxhits.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemaxhits.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Repo Men
cinemaxhits.us.description: In the future, medical technology has advanced to the point where people can buy artificial organs to extend their lives. But if they default on payments, an organization known as the Union sends agents to repossess the organs. Remy (Jude Law) is one of the best agents in the business, but when he becomes the recipient of an artificial heart, he finds himself in the same dire straits as his many victims. With his former partner (Forest Whitaker) in hot pursuit, Remy runs for his life. (movie) - 2010

cinesony.us.title: First Knight
cinesony.us.description: La pasión de Lancelot por Guinevere, y el deseo del malvado Malagant por el poder, amenazan al Camelot del rey Arturo.

cinesony.us.title: Redbelt
cinesony.us.description: La integridad de un artista marcial está en peligro luego de que salva a una estrella de acción de un ataque y acepta un empleo en la industria del cine.

cinesony.us.title: Seraphim Falls
cinesony.us.description: En 1868, un decidido cazador y cuatro pistoleros contratados persiguen implacablemente a un hombre herido a través de Nevada.

cinesony.us.title: The Three Burials of Melquiades Estrada
cinesony.us.description: Cuando el impetuoso agente fronterizo de Texas Mike Norton mata y entierra injustamente al amigo y ranchero de Pete Perkins, este se acuerda de una promesa que hizo de enterrar a su amigo, Melquiades Estrada, en su pueblo natal en México.

cinesony.us.title: Cliffhanger
cinesony.us.description: Un alpinista y sus captores se persiguen por peligrosas montañas, en una singular lucha por obtener un dinero robado.

cinesony.us.title: Quarantine
cinesony.us.description: Una reportera y su camarógrafo quedan atrapados en un edificio y graban la epidemia de una enfermedad desconocida que transforma a los humanos en caníbales viciosos.

cinesony.us.title: Retreat
cinesony.us.description: En una isla aislada, el intento de una pareja para recuperarse de una tragedia personal es destrozado cuando un desconocido les informa de una enfermedad aérea que está arrasando con Europa.

cinesony.us.title: Captain Phillips
cinesony.us.description: En el año 2009, un grupo de piratas somalíes secuestran un barco carguero estadounidense y toman como rehenes a la tripulación. Entre ellos está el capitán del navío, Richard Phillips.

cinevault.us.title: Open Season
cinevault.us.description: Boog (Martin Lawrence), a 900-pound grizzly bear, is content entertaining tourists and living in park ranger Beth's (Debra Messing) barn. His life takes a drastic turn when he rescues a one-horned mule deer named Elliot (Ashton Kutcher) from a hunter (Gary Sinise), and is subsequently tranquilized and returned to the wild. Elliot and Boog recruit the other animals, notably a Scottish squirrel (Billy Connolly) and a beaver foreman, to help turn the tables on the hunters to make the woods safe.

cinevault.us.title: The Master of Disguise
cinevault.us.description: Pistachio Disguisey, a genial waiter at his father Fabrizio's Italian restaurant, possesses an uncanny knack for mimicry. What he doesn't know is that his talent is genetic, and that he is the descendant of a long line of Masters of Disguise, all of whom have inherited the secret family gift known as Energico. Initially, Pistachio is a klutz, but little by little, he learns to harness his inherited power, and sallies forth to utilize Energico to its fullest.

cinevault.us.title: Apple of My Eye
cinevault.us.description: A tragic accident causes a young equestrian (Avery Arendes) to lose her sight and her ability to connect with anyone or anything, until a miniature horse named Apple is trained to be her companion and surrogate eyes.

cinevault.us.title: Ice Castles
cinevault.us.description: A figure skater searches for inner strength after a tragic accident jeopardizes her future.

cinevault.us.title: Places in the Heart
cinevault.us.description: In 1935 rural Texas, recently widowed Edna Spalding struggles to survive with two small children, a farm to run and very little money in the bank -- not to mention a deadly tornado and the unwelcome presence of the Ku Klux Klan. Edna is aided by her beautician sister, Margaret; a blind boarder, Mr. Will; and a would-be thief, Moze, who decides to stick around to teach Edna how to plant and harvest cotton.

cinevault.us.title: A River Runs Through It
cinevault.us.description: The Maclean brothers, Paul and Norman, live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly-fishing. The sons of a minister, the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going.

cinevault.us.title: The Natural
cinevault.us.description: On the way to a tryout with the Chicago Cubs, young baseball phenom Roy Hobbs (Robert Redford) is shot by the unstable Harriet Bird (Barbara Hershey). After 16 years, Hobbs returns to pro baseball as a rookie for the last-place New York Knights. Despite early arguments with his manager, Pop Fisher (Wilford Brimley), Hobbs becomes one of the best players in the league, and the Knights start winning. But this upsets the Judge (Robert Prosky), their owner, who wants Hobbs to lose games, not win.

circlecountry.us.title: Ben and Charlie
circlecountry.us.description: Two likable bandits (George Eastman, Giuliano Gemma) try to make a living in the Old West.

circlecountry.us.title: The Shooting
circlecountry.us.description: In the American West, Willet Gashade (Warren Oates), a former bounty hunter, and Coley Boyard (Will Hutchins), his dimwitted partner, are approached by a secretive young woman (Millie Perkins) who offers them money to guide her through the desert but refuses to discuss why she is traveling. The group embarks on the journey and is eventually joined by Billy Spear (Jack Nicholson), a volatile gunslinger the woman has also hired. The only question is why.

circlecountry.us.title: Barbarosa
circlecountry.us.description: In pre-Civil War Texas, naïve Karl Westover (Gary Busey) accidentally kills his brother-in-law, and heads to Mexico to escape the consequences. Along the way, he encounters Barbarosa (Willie Nelson), who is also on the run. Barbarosa teaches Karl survival skills for the desert — and how to rob. In their journey from Texas to Mexico and back again, the two men are captured by outlaw Angel Morales, and pursued by Don Braulio (Gilbert Roland), who wants Barbarosa dead.

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - The Courtship of Floyd Smoot
circlecountry.us.description: Kate tries to restore the self-confidence of Floyd Smoot after he is jilted by his mail-order sweetheart, by pretending to be in love with him.

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - Please Buy My Violets
circlecountry.us.description: Uncle Joe decides to go into the cologne business.

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - The Ringer
circlecountry.us.description: Betty Jo becomes the first female contestant in the horseshoe tournament.

circlecountry.us.title: Circle Shorts
circlecountry.us.description: A bite-sized taste of country lifestyle, Southern travel, artist interviews and down-home food.

classica.us.title: Clara Haskil - Das Geheimnis der Interpretin
classica.us.description: Für Freunde und Musiker war und ist die Schweizer Klaviervirtuosin Clara Haskil eine Interpretin, die wie keine andere Maßstäbe gesetzt hat. Anhand von Klaviereinspielungen, Briefen und Interviews zeigt der Film die Musikerin in neuem Licht.

classica.us.title: Schostakowitsch - Concertino für zwei Klaviere
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmet sich die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich dem Repertoire für Klavier und Violine in diesem wunderbaren Konzert, das im Château de Chantilly in Frankreich aufgezeichnet wurde.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: Strauss' Metamorphosen & Mozart's Requiem
classica.us.description: Franz Welser-Möst dirigiert das Cleveland Orchestra und den Chor in einem Konzert mit Werken von Richard Strauss, Metamorphosen, und Mozarts Requiem. Die Solisten sind Siobhan Stagg, Avery Amereau, Ben Bliss und Anthony Robin Schneider. Aufgenommen wurde dies in der Severance Hall, Cleveland im März 2023.

classica.us.title: Music in the Air
classica.us.description: Millionen Menschen sehen jedes Jahr die Live-Übertragung des Neujahrskonzerts. Als die Drei Tenöre anlässlich der Fußball-WM 1990 ihr legendäres Konzert in Rom gaben, sahen weltweit eine Milliarde Menschen an den Fernsehern zu. Die Dokumentation untersucht, welche Möglichkeiten das Fernsehen bietet, klassische Musik einem breiten Publikum näherzubringen. Was dachten Herbert von Karajan und Leonard Bernstein darüber, die als einige der ersten die Möglichkeiten dieses Mediums intensiv nutzten?

classica.us.title: Tschaikowski - 2. Sinfonie, op. 17
classica.us.description: Das London Symphony Orchestra spielt unter der Leitung des Amerikaners Michael Tilson Thomas Tschaikowskys Symphonie Nr. 2 in c-Moll. Die Symphonie trägt auch den Spitznamen "Kleinrussische", da ukrainische Volkslieder mit einflossen.

classica.us.title: Schumann - Kreisleriana, op. 16
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Schwartz Schumanns Werk "Kreisleriana, Op. 16". Schumann behauptete, dass er diese Komposition von 1838 in nur vier Tagen niederschrieb. Er widmete sie Frédéric Chopin, seinem Zeitgenossen.

classica.us.title: Bach - 4. Brandenburgisches Konzert
classica.us.description: J. S. Bachs sechs Brandenburgische Konzerte gehören zu seinen bekanntesten Werken. Bei dieser Aufführung im Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses präsentieren Luks und sein Collegium 1704 Bachs Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 4 in G-Dur.

classica.us.title: Bach, Goldberg-Variationen BWV 988
classica.us.description: Zhu Xiao-Mei (Klavier). Aufgenommen beim Bachfest Leipzig in der Thomaskirche. Die chinesische Pianistin Zhu Xiao-Mei wurde während Maos Kulturrevolution verhaftet und in ein Arbeitslager gesteckt. Erst Jahre später gelang ihr die Flucht ins Ausland.

classica.us.title: Werke von Beethoven und Saint-Saëns
classica.us.description: Im Jahr 2021 feiert Martha Argerich ihren 80. Geburtstag mit einem Konzert im Château de Chantilly, Frankreich. Bei diesem Konzert wird Argerich von dem Cellisten Mischa Maisky, dem Geiger Maxim Vengerov und dem Pianisten Iddo Bar-Shaï begleitet.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 9 in d-Moll, op. 125
classica.us.description: Das Orchester de l'Opéra national de Paris unter Leitung von Philippe Jordan interpretiert die neunte Symphonie von Ludwig van Beethoven. Die Solisten sind Ricarda Merbeth, Daniela Sindram, Robert Dean Smith und Günther Groissböck.

classica.us.title: Luisi dirigiert Paganinis Violinkonzert und Brahms
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Fabio Luisi ist mit dem Dänischen Radio-Sinfonieorchester aufgetreten. Sie führten Paganinis 1. Violinkonzert und Brahms' dramatisches Sinfonie-Debüt, die 1. Sinfonie, auf. Beide Werke erfreuen sich außerordentlicher Beliebtheit.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Streichquartett Nr. 5, op. 18, Nr. 5
classica.us.description: Das Quatuor Ébène feiert Beethovens 250. Geburtstag mit der Aufnahme aller sechzehn Streichquartette. Über fünf Jahre arbeiteten die Musiker an den Partituren, bevor sie das Repertoire in sechs Konzerten in der Philharmonie de Paris aufführten.

classica.us.title: Beethoven, Klavierkonzert Nr. 3 c-Moll op. 37
classica.us.description: Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827): Klavierkonzert Nr. 3 c-Moll op. 37. Yefim Bronfman (Klavier), Staatskapelle Dresden, Leitung: Christian Thielemann. Aufgenommen in der Semperoper Dresden. Beethovens Ausdrucksmittel für Sturm und Drang war c-Moll: In dieser Tonart schrieb er seine dramatischsten und heroischsten Werke, darunter die 5. Symphonie und die Klaviersonate op. 13, seine berühmte "Pathétique".

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: Dvořák - Slawische Tänze, op. 46 (Nr. 1-8)
classica.us.description: Sir Simon Rattle dirigiert das London Symphony Orchestra in Antonín Dvořáks schwungvollen slawischen Tänzen, Op. 46 (Nr. 1-8). Diese Aufführung wurde am 23. September 2020 in St. Luke's in London, Großbritannien, aufgenommen.

classica.us.title: The Unanswered Ives
classica.us.description: Charles Ives ist ein Mann der Dissonanzen - und das in fast allen Bereichen seines Lebens. Seit seiner Kindheit gilt seine Liebe dem Spiel mit der Musik. Doch Charles wurde zu einer Zeit geboren, als man klassische Musiker für Memmen hielt.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Hands Off, Grandma
cleotv.us.description: Nikki's recently widowed nana (guest star Isabel Sanford) tries to hook up with professor Oglevee (Dorien Wilson). J. Anthony Brown guest stars.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Blind Date Mistake
cleotv.us.description: Kim and Nikki (Countess Vaughn, Mo'Nique) are paired with a father and son (John Marshall Jones, Fred Thomas) on the TV show "Blind Date." Roger Lodge guest stars.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Field of Dreams
cleotv.us.description: Kim and Stevie try to live without the convenience of African-American inventions; Nikki honors her great uncle.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Who's Your Mama?
cleotv.us.description: A young woman claims that she and Kim (Countess Vaughn) were switched at birth. With Mo'Nique. Guest star: D.L. Hughley.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Mama, I Want to Sing
cleotv.us.description: The church choir begs for mercy when Nikki (Mo'Nique) replaces Kim (Countess Vaughn) as soloist. Guest star: Joseph C. Phillips, Fred Hammond and Kym E. Whitley.

cleotv.us.title: The Parkers - Single Black Female
cleotv.us.description: Nikki's new friend (guest star Karen Bankhead) begins to imitate her in a creepy way; Kim (Countess Vaughn) gives up solid foods for two weeks. With Mo'Nique.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - How Will I Know?
cleotv.us.description: J.T. and Grant (Sharif Atkins) both propose to Shelly at her birthday party.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - Shelly And...
cleotv.us.description: As Shelly starts making plans for the wedding, her mother, Beverly (Penny Johnson Jerald), visits and tries to convince her that marriage is a bad idea.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - Three Divas, No Style
cleotv.us.description: A personal and professional feud with Shelly erupts when Janie and Rita decide to start their own line of items at DivaStyle.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - The Lyin', the Witch and the Wardrobe
cleotv.us.description: Unable to fit into her own dress, Shelly decides to wear a customer's dress to the Black and White Ball with Jalen, only to be caught by the client.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - The Price of Friendship
cleotv.us.description: Shelly and Janie argue over lottery winnings, putting their longstanding friendship at risk.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - Break Up to Make-Up
cleotv.us.description: Rita threatens to leave the partnership when Shelly and Janie refuse to let her be the new face of DivaStyle.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - Model Behavior
cleotv.us.description: Shelly and Janie learn their former partner will be modeling for their biggest competitor as they prepare to unveil their new clothing line.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - Janie, Shut Up!
cleotv.us.description: When Janie vents about her mother-in-law on a popular radio show, she ends up revealing more information than she intended.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - Brit Better Have My Money
cleotv.us.description: During an interview with a local news reporter, the women learn that the manufacturer of their new clothing line runs a sweat shop.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - Marty in the Middle
cleotv.us.description: Janie becomes convinced that Marty secretly has a crush on Shelly.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - All About Eve
cleotv.us.description: Arriving home for the holidays, Shelly discovers that one of her mother's favorite students has taken over her bedroom.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - Banishing Acts
cleotv.us.description: After learning of his former relationship with Shelly, J.T.'s new girlfriend Rochelle (Kim Fields) feels threatened and demands that J.T. choose between her and Shelly.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - Diva Day Care
cleotv.us.description: Shelly questions her maternal instincts after she drops Janie's baby cousin and must rush the frightened child to the hospital.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - Mo' Money, Mo' Problems
cleotv.us.description: Just as business begins to boom at DivaStyle, creating windfall profits, Janie's husband decides to quit his job.

cleotv.us.title: Eve - Oh Brother
cleotv.us.description: When Janie's baby brother Paul (Ruben Studdard) comes to visit, Shelly discovers that his long-time crush on her still exists.

cmt.us.title: The King of Queens - Loaner Car
cmt.us.description: Doug loans Carrie to Deacon for a couple of days to help him get ready for his big Thanksgiving dinner.

cmt.us.title: The King of Queens - Thanks, Man
cmt.us.description: An unexpected visit from a stranger interrupts the Heffernans' Thanksgiving dinner. Lou Ferrigno and Merrin Dungey guest star.

cmt.us.title: We're the Millers
cmt.us.description: Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished; trying to help some teens, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now, David's in big debt to his supplier and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: He packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang.

cmt.us.title: Vacation
cmt.us.description: Remembering fond, childhood memories of his trip to Walley World, Rusty Griswold surprises his wife and two sons with a cross-country excursion to America's favorite fun park. Following in his father's footsteps, Rusty and the gang pack up the car and hit the road for some much-needed family bonding. Soon, the promise of fun turns into one misadventure after another for the next generation of Griswolds and anyone who encounters them. (movie) - 2015

The program and its team have earned critical acclaim, including multiple Emmy, Peabody and Edward R. Murrow Awards.

motortrend.us.description: In the snowy landscape of Michigan's Northern Peninsula, Derek finds a 1964 Ford Galaxie that's sat abandoned for 32 years; he plans to not only get this Ford running, but also to turn it into a rally-tribute car.

motortrend.us.title: Roadworthy Rescues - Jeep J-Too Sketchy
motortrend.us.description: Derek teams up with Dave Chappelle to revitalize a 1972 Jeep J2000 that's sat among a field of neglected Jeeps; together, they cobble together parts from various Jeeps to get theirs running and attempt to make the 100-mile journey to Derek's shop. (Automotive)

motortrend.us.title: Roadworthy Rescues - Gutterball Cutlass
motortrend.us.description: Derek teams up with his brother Sean to convert a 1966 Oldsmobile F-85 from a wannabe drag racer into a timeless cruiser; it'll take more than a paint job to make this car street-able, as the guys discover the engine is keeping a horrible secret. (Automotive)

motortrend.us.title: Roadworthy Rescues - Overtime Dually
motortrend.us.description: Derek Bieri and Dave Chappelle find an old dually among a flock of chickens; with the goal of building this rig into a car-hauling shop truck, Derek sets his sights on major performance upgrades, while Dave gets to work on a custom suspension setup. (Automotive)

motortrend.us.title: Roadworthy Rescues - Hatchet Coronet
motortrend.us.description: Derek enlists Steve Dulcich to help restore a derelict Dodge Coronet; with a seized drivetrain, they must replace everything to complete a 500-mile road trip to Nashville. (Automotive)

motortrend.us.title: Roadworthy Rescues - Budget Burt
motortrend.us.description: Derek heads to Alabama in search of a Bandit replica; instead, he finds a Trans Am that's the wrong year, wrong color, wrong engine and has clearly been in a wreck; that won't stop Derek from attempting to turn it into a car worthy of Burt himself. (Automotive)

motortrend.us.title: Roadworthy Rescues - Cowbell Chevelle
motortrend.us.description: Derek and his brother Sean head back to their family farm in North Dakota; intent on building a goin'-to-town rig for the old farmstead, they dig out a 1971 Chevrolet Chevelle sedan that's buried in cow pies and has a waterlogged engine. (Automotive)

motortrend.us.title: Roadworthy Rescues - Great 8N
motortrend.us.description: In need of a new riding lawn mower, Derek heads east to find himself a 1950 Ford 8N tractor; with a cracked engine block and a bees' nest for a battery, Derek will have to revisit his farming routes to make this implement operational. (Automotive)

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Rotsun Lives Again!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The 1971 240Z rust bucket known as Rotsun has never failed to fail; David and Mike want to get it back up and running after years of neglect and drive it to SEMA.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Diesel Swapped Drag Racing Torino Wagon!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Mike and Tony divert from a road trip to accept a challenge from drag racer Cleetus McFarland; it's a battle of diesel-swapped Fords, and the guys will take Mike's 1971 Torino wagon to new levels to get ready for it.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Hilarious Car Shootout
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Mike and David buy each other their worst automotive nightmares and put them to the test against Steve in a showdown; Finnegan rides high, Freiburger works through some "cosmetic" damage and Dulcich rampages through fire.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Blown T-Bird Winter Road Trip!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The T-Bizzle is an '86 Thunderbird powered by a 302 V8, topped with a 6-71 blower and welded gears; Freiburger and Finnegan take it across the frozen tundra of the northern U.S., on a classic road trip with plenty of fail.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Top Project Car Updates!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Freiburger and Finnegan come to audience from their own garages to look at the Top Project Cars of Roadkill; they'll explore what happened to fan favorites, what the guys really thought of them and what the future holds.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - D100 Pick Up Rescue!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Freiburger and Finnegan clean out wheels that have been stashed in the garage for far too long by slapping them on a neglected '66 Dodge D100 Utiline truck; they hit the road on a quest to find the perfect 440 for it.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - At-Home Build-Off: COVID 350 vs Mini Truck!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Freiburger scrounges his parts pile to put together a killer 350 V8 while Finnegan and David Newbern add some power upgrades to the mini.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Cheap 4x4 Challenge!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Freiburger has always touted the superiority of the Suburban, while Dulchich rallies a Durango; now they finally resolve who has the better cheap 4x4.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Budget Drag Build and Battle!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The guys have a build off and race like no other; Tony transforms a shell of an '85 Monte Carlo into a beast, while Finnegan makes Newbern's Nova run with ramp truck parts; it's three days of wrenching, two tracks and one unbelievable race.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Barn Find Firebird Rescue!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Mike Finnegan and David Newbern rescue a mint '67 Pontiac Firebird that has been stowed in a barn for almost two decades; the guys battle old parts, downpours and other issues in order to get this old drag car racing down the track once again.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Road Trippin' the Wreck Runner!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Freiburger and Dulcich hit the road in the '68 Wreck Runner, a four-speed, 383ci clone made from the scraps of a '68 Road Runner and a '68 Satellite; it only has a few little issues; they hit the road to sort 'em out.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Barnfind Firebird vs. Crusher Camaro!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Finnegan and Newbern take the barn-find '67 Firebird on an 800-mile road trip to race Freiburger and Dulcich in the Crusher Camaro.

movieplex.us.description: Mindy adopts Angel, a high-spirited pony that according to legend will lead its owner to gold hidden in the nearby mountains. movieplex.us.description: An evil, jaded wizard makes it his business to rid the realm of love. Now, a brave warrior and his reluctant brother stand between the good people of the world and a fleet of fire-breathing dragons. (movie) - 2015

movies.us.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
movies.us.description: Easily excitable Neal Page (Steve Martin) is somewhat of a control freak. Trying to get home to Chicago to spend Thanksgiving with his wife (Laila Robins) and kids, his flight is rerouted to a distant city in Kansas because of a freak snowstorm, and his sanity begins to fray. Worse yet, he is forced to bunk up with talkative Del Griffith (John Candy), whom he finds extremely annoying. Together they must overcome the insanity of holiday travel to reach their intended destination.

movies.us.title: Mission: Impossible Rogue Nation
movies.us.description: With the IMF now disbanded and Ethan Hunt out in the cold, a new threat -- called the Syndicate -- soon emerges. The Syndicate is a network of highly skilled operatives who are dedicated to establishing a new world order via an escalating series of terrorist attacks. Faced with what may be the most impossible mission yet, Ethan gathers his team and joins forces with Ilsa Faust, a disavowed British agent who may or may not be a member of this deadly rogue nation.

movies.us.title: Mission: Impossible -- Fallout
movies.us.description: Ethan Hunt and the IMF team join forces with CIA assassin August Walker to prevent a disaster of epic proportions. Arms dealer John Lark and a group of terrorists known as the Apostles plan to use three plutonium cores for a simultaneous nuclear attack on the Vatican, Jerusalem and Mecca, Saudi Arabia. When the weapons go missing, Ethan and his crew find themselves in a desperate race against time to prevent them from falling into the wrong hands.

movies.us.title: Mission: Impossible -- Dead Reckoning Part One
movies.us.description: Ethan Hunt and the IMF team must track down a terrifying new weapon that threatens all of humanity if it falls into the wrong hands. With control of the future and the fate of the world at stake, a deadly race around the globe begins. Confronted by a mysterious, all-powerful enemy, Ethan is forced to consider that nothing can matter more than the mission -- not even the lives of those he cares about most. (movie) - 2023

movies.us.title: Top Gun
movies.us.description: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick (Tom Cruise) is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman (Val Kilmer). But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis). (movie) - 1986

movies.us.title: Top Gun: Maverick
movies.us.description: After more than 30 years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators, Pete "Maverick" Mitchell is where he belongs, pushing the envelope as a courageous test pilot and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him. Training a detachment of graduates for a special assignment, Maverick must confront the ghosts of his past and his deepest fears, culminating in a mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice from those who choose to fly it. (movie) - 2022

movies.us.title: Days of Thunder
movies.us.description: In the fast-paced world of NASCAR, a rivalry brews between rookie hotshot Cole Trickle (Tom Cruise) and veteran racer Rowdy Burns (Michael Rooker). When both of them are seriously injured in competition, the former bitter rivals become close friends. With Cole's spirits restored by a romance with neurosurgeon Dr. Claire Lewicki (Nicole Kidman), and Rowdy still sidelined by injuries, Cole decides to race Rowdy's car in the Daytona 500 against underhanded newcomer Russ Wheeler (Cary Elwes). (movie) - 1990

movies.us.title: Collateral
movies.us.description: A cab driver realizes his current fare is a hit man that has been having him drive around from mark to mark until the last witness to a crime is dead. When the cabbie finally figures out the truth, he must prevent the assassin from wiping out his last witness without becoming the next in the professional killer's line of casualties. (movie) - 2004

mtv2west.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull

He meets Mutt (Shia La Beouf), a young man who wants Indy to help him find the legendary Crystal Skull of Akator, and the pair set out for Peru. However, deadly agent Irina Spalko (Cate Blanchett) is searching for the powerful artifact, too, because the Soviets believe it can help them conquer the world.

nickjr.uk.description: Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George are going to the seaside. Mummy and Daddy explain clouds to Peppa and George who have a little sing and dance about clouds. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr. Bull Digs Up The River
nickjr.uk.description: Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They see Mr. Bull, who's using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Granny Sheep Moves In
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa is playing at Suzy's house and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in! She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Cardboard Boxes
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa is at Suzy's house and there is a pile of cardboard boxes so, they take them outside to play with. Peppa turns the boxes into a cardboard shop, a spaceship and even a hospital. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Clubhouse Takeaway
nickjr.uk.description: Suzy describes a takeaway and the children want to make their own. Together they 'cook' and deliver the pretend takeaways to the parents. They get great reviews too. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Walkie Talkies
nickjr.uk.description: Grandpa Pig has created a watering system, but he does not remember which button is which so Peppa and George help using walkie talkies. The Police hear their signal and are surprised. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Peppa's Office
nickjr.uk.description: Mummy and Daddy Pig are working in their home office and Peppa wants to 'work' like them too. Peppa decides that she needs her own office, so she takes the cupboard under the stairs. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Little Swift
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa and her family take a poorly swift to the vet's. After a night of rest, the swift recovers and Doctor Hamster releases it so it can fly around the world again. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - What Babies Do
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's House to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa learns babies are not like dolls at all, and do lots of things every day. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Lenses
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa hands Penny and Pedro the wrong glasses by mistake and they can't see very well. Madame Gazelle then tells them the importance of lenses and how they're in all sorts of things. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - The Elf Band
nickjr.uk.description: Snobby King and Queen Marigold are coming to visit the Little Kingdom, and Holly and her Mummy and Daddy enlist the Elf Band to impress them. (Action & Adventure, Animation, Comedy, Family, Kids) - 2009

nickjr.uk.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - The VIP
nickjr.uk.description: King Leopold has announced he is paying a visit to The Little Kingdom. Everyone is very excited that they have a VIP coming and prepare to welcome him. But King Thistle is feeling left out. (Action & Adventure, Animation, Comedy, Family, Kids) - 2009

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Outback
nickjr.uk.description: The Pig family visit the Kangaroo family in Australia! On their first day they fly into the outback in Mr Kangaroo's aeroplane, have a barbeque and play some cricket with a Koala. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Surfing
nickjr.uk.description: On their second day in Australia the Kangaroo family take the Pig family to the beach where they try out surfing. George shows off his skills when he's out paddling with Daddy Pig. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Great Barrier Reef
nickjr.uk.description: Today the family go to work with Mrs Kangaroo on the Great Barrier Reef. While taking in the beautiful views in Mrs Kangaroo's submarine, they find some special treasure. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Boomerang
nickjr.uk.description: The holiday is coming to an end but there's still time to play with a Boomerang and make friends with Mr Wallaby. They all have trouble keeping the boomerang under control, though. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Patchwork Quilt
nickjr.uk.description: Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Granny Sheep's Art Van
nickjr.uk.description: Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Being Inspired
nickjr.uk.description: Granny Sheep is driving Vanessa, the art van along the road with Peppa, Suzy, Pedro, Mandy, Molly and Danny. They are taking her to the boat yard, for her first-ever outing. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjr.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Sibling School
nickjr.uk.description: While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School, and learn about what to expect when the baby arrives. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Tractor
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Lifeboat
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grampy Rabbit teaches Danny Dog and Peppa why his lifeboat is so important when it comes to saving lives at sea, and gives them tips on how to stay safe.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Superhero Party
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Pedro loves superheroes. He has a superhero-themed party and Super Potato is one of the guests.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Happily Ever After
nickjrtoo.uk.description: At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own endings too.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Movie Night
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night. But before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, and which popcorn to eat.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Clubhouse Adventure
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The children make good use of their clubhouse by playing an adventure game, imaginging that there are wild animals outside - even if it is just Daddy Pig.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Breakfast Club
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends go to school early to have breakfast together.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Cleaning the Car
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The family car is very muddy. Peppa and George have lots of fun helping Mummy and Daddy clean it.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Pedro's Cough
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Pedro gets a cough at playschool and the other children quickly catch it. Doctor Brownbear is called and gives them horrible medicine, but who will look after him when he is ill.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Freddy Fox
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it's Freddy Fox with his super smelling nose who is the best at playing that game.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr. Bull's New Road
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa takes Goldie the Goldfish for a visit to the vets and is surprised when she finds that there's a new road to be built over the building.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Teddy's Day Out
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa loses Teddy at a picnic, and Zoe Zebra has to rescue him.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Baby Piggy
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George meet their new cousin, a tiny baby piggy called Alexander.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Cold Winter's Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is a very cold winter day. Peppa and George are wearing their hats, scarves, mittens and coats. They want to jump in muddy puddles, but the puddles are all frozen and slippery.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mirrors
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George has fun looking at himself in the mirror and tries to find other shiny things.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - New Shoes
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa gets shiny new red shoes and never, ever wants to take them off - until it's time to jump in muddy puddles.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Gardening
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George enjoy helping Grandpa Pig plant seeds in his garden.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Granny Pig's Chickens
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny Pig shows Peppa and George her chickens, whilst something has been eating Grandpa Pig's lettuces.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grampy Rabbit's Lighthouse
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa Pig takes Peppa, George and Danny Dog to visit Grampy Rabbit's lighthouse. Grampy Rabbit knows all about the sea, and can make a lot of noise too, which is useful.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Rainy Day Game
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is raining outside so Peppa and George have to stay indoors. While they wait for the rain to stop, Daddy Pig teaches them a fun game.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Daddy Pig's Office
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's all play and not much work when Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - School Camp
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends are going camping. Madame Gazelle, their teacher, is in charge. First they put up their tents. Then they collect sticks to make a campfire.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Gerald Giraffe
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Gerald Giraffe is new to playgroup! He's trying to make friends with Peppa and the group, but finds being so tall is making playing hide and seek quite a challenge.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Digger World
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy and Daddy Pig, Peppa and George have a wonderful day with Mr. Potato at Digger World.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mister Skinnylegs
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George finds a very friendly spider in the bathroom. Peppa doesn't like spiders and screams very loudly. But soon she realises that the little spider doesn't want to hurt her.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Delphine Donkey
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa's French friend Delphine Donkey comes to stay. Peppa takes Delphine to playgroup where they teach her the 'Bing Bong Song.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grandpa Pig's Computer
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig gives her old computer to Granny and Grandpa Pig. They use it for lots of important work - as well as Happy Mrs Chicken. But who will fix it when it breaks.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Edmond Elephant's Birthday
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends go to help at Edmond Elephant's birthday party, but the little children are harder to look after than they'd thought.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Rock Pools
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George learn there's lots of fun to be had at the beach, even when there's no sand.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Ambulance
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Dr. Brown Bear comes to visit the playgroup and teach all of the children what to do when there's been an accident.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Spider Web
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig finds a spider in the house and orders Daddy Pig to get rid of it. Mr Skinny-Legs is set free in the garden, where he can spin all the webs he likes, wherever he likes.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Police Car
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Swimming Lesson
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Miss Rabbit takes the children for swimming lessons in the little children's pool. At the end of the lesson, giant inflatables are brought out including an inflatable slide.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Singing Competition
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Today is the grown-ups' singing competition at the theatre and the kids are the judges. The children jump up and down and sing along. Everybody loves singing.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Duck Race
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Big Build
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mr Bull arrives with his team to start work on Peppa's house renovation. Peppa and family move into the caravan in the garden while the work is being completed.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Made Up Musical Instruments
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle gets the playgroup to play music - with instruments that they must make themselves.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Playing Golf
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful minigolf course next door.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Lots of Muddy Puddles
nickjrtoo.uk.description: On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Being Babies
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Dr Hamster's Ant Farm
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Dr Hamster is visiting the playgroup today and has brought a giant ant farm. But nobody notices when they escape and start moving things in the classroom.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Granny Sheep Moves In
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa is playing at Suzy's house and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in! She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grampy Rabbit's Jetpack
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grampy Rabbit's new jet pack shoots off into the distance and he ends up on top of a snowy mountain.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mountain Climbing
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends learn about climbing from Grampy Rabbit at the climbing centre. Mummy Pig is worried about George when he gets scared of heights.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Funny Music
nickjrtoo.uk.description: A new synthesiser arrives for Daddy Pig, and his family collect sounds for it from around the house while he is out at work.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Cushion Den
nickjrtoo.uk.description: On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Adventure Caravan
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure and the first stop is The Biggest Potato in the World. When it starts to get foggy, they park up before another busy day.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Clubhouse Takeaway
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Suzy describes a takeaway and the children want to make their own. Together they 'cook' and deliver the pretend takeaways to the parents. They get great reviews too.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Walkie Talkies
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa Pig has created a watering system, but he does not remember which button is which so Peppa and George help using walkie talkies. The Police hear their signal and are surprised.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Fire Station Practice
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig joins with the other mummies to practise fighting fires at the fire station. The fire brigade demonstrate their practice using their motto.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - World Book Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: For World Book Day, the playgroup must dress up as a character from their favourite book. But Peppa can't decide which as she has so many favourites.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Indoor Adventure
nickjrtoo.uk.description: A storm cancels Peppa and her family's adventure plans so they decide to take it inside. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and have a campfire in the attic.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Chloe's Birthday Party
nickjrtoo.uk.description: At Chloe's party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the obstacle course to reach the prize. George is the last to try and finds the birthday cake.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Being Inspired
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny Sheep is driving Vanessa, the art van along the road with Peppa, Suzy, Pedro, Mandy, Molly and Danny. They are taking her to the boat yard, for her first-ever outing.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Trampolines
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends head to the trampoline park where Miss Rabbit shows them how to bounce. Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Mummy Sheep decide they want to have a go at trampolining.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grampy Rabbit in Space
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grampy Rabbit visits Peppa's playgroup to talk about space rockets.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Ballet Lesson
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa goes to her first ballet lesson. Peppa loves dancing. Everyone loves dancing.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr Dinosaur is Lost
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George is upset when he loses his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur. Peppa becomes a detective to track it down.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - George's Birthday
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George has the best birthday ever, including a visit to the Dinosaur Museum.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Champion Daddy Pig
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig loses his title as Champion Puddle Jumper, until everyone helps him train to win it back.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Emily Elephant
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa meets her new playschool friend Emily Elephant.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Painting
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George have fun making potato prints and painting a lovely picture of a cherry tree.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Suzy Goes Away
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Sheep gets the news that she has got a new job far away, leaving Suzy and Peppa to wonder how they're going to carry on being best friends.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Sandpit
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends are building a desert island, in the sandpit. They add a forest, a lake, houses, and shops. It's all going very well until George and Richard's dinosaurs turn up.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George play at being pretty butterflies, wriggly worms and muddy frogs.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Piggy in the Middle
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George play piggy-in-the-middle. George catches the ball with a little help from Daddy Pig.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Danny's Pirate Party
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's Danny Dog's birthday, and with the help of Grandad Dog and Grandpa Pig, the children take part in a pirate treasure hunt.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Baby Alexander
nickjrtoo.uk.description: What's that sound? Is it a car alarm? Is it a fire engine? No, it's Baby Alexander. Babies cry a lot - but Alexander likes listening to Peppa. She knows about all sorts of things.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Shadows
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George notice they have shadows, and no matter how fast they walk, run, or jump - they can't lose them.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Nursery Rhymes
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle and the playgroup are sharing their best nursery rhymes with each other.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Playgroup Star
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa gets her very first Playgroup Star in school for drawing a wonderful picture of her house.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Castle
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to a castle to feast on medieval banquets, play King and Queen and even meet a dragon. It's George's favourite day ever.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Carnival
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The Carnival has come to town and it's a chance to see all sorts of exciting people and floats.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Playground
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George are at the playground with their friends. Peppa gets stuck in the tyre on the climbing frame, and Daddy Pig gets stuck on the slide.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Simple Science
nickjrtoo.uk.description: While the playground is getting rebuilt, Daddy Pig teaches the children some simple science.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Molly Mole
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is Molly Mole's first day at school and she quickly makes best friends with Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Madame Gazelle's House
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy Pig have gone to visit Madame Gazelle and her wonky house.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Time Capsule
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends make a time capsule and bury it in the school garden.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Dentist
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Dr. Elephant the Dentist says that Peppa and George both have lovely clean teeth.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Please and Thank You
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George learn some wonderful magic words. Nice things happen when you say please and thank you.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Lucky Hamper
nickjrtoo.uk.description: While Peppa and her friends are at Playgroup, Madame Gazelle tells them about a Lucky Hamper of goodies they are going to make and place in a charity raffle.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Folk Music Band
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George are in Granny and Grandpa Pig's Garden. Granny's friends are playing folk music! They play music for Grandpa Pig and then Grandpa Pig makes apple juice for everyone.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Living Above the Shops
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in an apartment above the shops. Peggi and Pandora Panda, and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Lenses
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa hands Penny and Pedro the wrong glasses by mistake and they can't see very well. Madame Gazelle then tells them the importance of lenses and how they're in all sorts of things.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Guinea Pigs
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa looks after Madame Gazelle's guinea pigs Ginger and Brian while she goes on holiday, but prove to be more trouble for Mummy and Daddy Pig than they think.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Windmills
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends are at playgroup when Mr. Bull arrives to do some noisy work - he is building a windmill, to make electricity! The children join in and make their own windmills too.

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: Sandy creates a new invention to avoid doing chores in 'Are You Smarter Than A Smart Cabin', and then in 'Deep Sea Despot', Squidward takes over as Camp Master. (S1, ep 22)

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick's dad unexpectedly visits Kamp Koral in 'Help Not Wanted', then in 'Camp Spirit', SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy befriend a visiting ghost camper. (S1, ep 14)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob makes a delivery to E.V.I.L. in 'Delivery of Doom', then in 'My Father the Boat', Pearl gets a new boat. (S15, ep 11)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: The Star Family is a team of superheroes in 'Super Stars', and then in 'Now Museum, Now You Don't', Cecil works security at Lady Upturn's art museum. (S2, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: The Patricks compete for control of the TV remote in 'Pat-Tathlon', then in 'Upturn's Downturn', after driving over Patrick, a court order forces Lady Upturn to live with the Star family. (S4, ep 8)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Some undersea superheroes are back in 'Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy III', and then in 'Squirrel Jokes', SpongeBob's derogatory comedy is not at all funny to Sandy Squirrel. (S2, ep 11)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: The Patrick Show gets competing sponsors in 'The Patrick Show Sells Out', then in 'Neptune's Ball', the Star family visits King Neptune's palace. (S1, ep 21)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: In an episode about boats, Cecil teaches Patrick how to drive in 'Driven to Drive', then in 'A Patty in Time', Patrick time-travels in a race for the Krusty Krab's newest menu item. (S3, ep 5)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Mr Krabs makes his number one employee take his first ever day off, in 'Bummer Vacation', and then in 'Wig Struck', SpongeBob finds an old wig, and wears it all around town, thinking that it's cool.

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: The weekly food delivery truck goes missing in 'Quest for Tire', and in 'A Cabin of Curiosities', a mysterious cabin of odd campers have frightful fun with SpongeBob and Patrick after dark. (S1, ep 3)

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: Gary's new habit causes a night of stress in 'Un-Breaking and De-Entering', then in 'Swimmin' Holed', Narlene and Nobby's secret swimming hole is exposed. (S2, ep 7)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick decides it's time to start living life like Larry the Lobster in 'A Life In A Day', and then in 'Sun Bleached', SpongeBob tries to get a tan, with disappointing results.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob and Patrick see a young Mermaidman and Barnacleboy in 'Back To The Past', and then there are more classic superhero adventures in 'The Bad Guy Club For Villains'.

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: The Yard Sale: GrandPat prevents his precious memories from being sold at a family yard sale. (S1, ep 4)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Bunny sends Squidina to camp, so Patrick works with new staff in 'Is there a Director in the House?', then in 'Star Cruise', the Star family enjoys a cruise ship vacation... in outer space. (S2, ep 8)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Mr Krabs resorts to desperate measures after Plankton drives away his customers in 'Free Samples', and then in 'Home Sweet Rubble', SpongeBob's pineapple is falling apart, and needs re-modelling.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: When Gary gets lost outside, he has to go on an incredible journey to get back home in 'Food Con Castaways', and then in 'Snail Mail', Spongebob accidentally fibs to his pen pal, and must keep it up!

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: The Dinghies travel to outer space in 'Hats Off to Space', then in 'In a Nut's Shell', After discovering his empty shell, Narlene and Nobby disguise themselves at Camp Master Krabs. (S1, ep 26)

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral

outlaw.us.title: Death Rides a Horse
outlaw.us.description: Having witnessed the brutal murder of his entire family by bandits at the age of 5, Bill Meceita has spent 15 years planning his vengeance. Finding a kindred spirit in Ryan, an experienced gunslinger seeking his own revenge on those who framed him, the two team up to find and kill Walcott, a fearsome bandit on the loose. But Bill soon discovers that Ryan may know more about his tragic past than he has let on.

outlaw.us.title: Angel and the Badman
outlaw.us.description: Quirt Evans (John Wayne), a cowboy on the run, is injured when his horse stumbles near a Quaker family's land. The family takes him in as he regains his health, and he falls for their young daughter, Penelope (Gail Russell). As Quirt falls deeper in love and becomes accustomed to the family's peaceful ways, his violent past starts to catch up to him. Eventually he is forced to decide whether it is worth letting go of his turbulent former life for his future with Penelope.

outlaw.us.title: 3 Godfathers
outlaw.us.description: Thieves and rustlers Robert Hightower (John Wayne), Pete Fuerte (Pedro Armendáriz) and the Abilene Kid (Harry Carey Jr.) rob a bank in a small Arizona town. Pursued across the desert by the indefatigable Sheriff Buck Sweet (Ward Bond), the trio lose their horses, suffer injuries, and come across a stranded woman (Mildred Natwick) who is dying while giving birth. Promising to carry the woman's newborn to safety, the repentant criminals struggle to reach the village of New Jerusalem.

outlaw.us.title: The Train Robbers

outlaw.us.title: Chisum
outlaw.us.description: Kind-hearted, fatherly John Chisum (John Wayne) owns a large ranch in Lincoln County, New Mexico, in the 1870s. With the help of his faithful sidekick, Pepper (Ben Johnson), and a hot-headed young ranch hand nicknamed Billy the Kid (Geoffrey Deuel), Chisum does battle with underhanded land developer Lawrence Murphy (Forrest Tucker). Having bought up most of the nearby town and appointed his own corrupt sheriff (Bruce Cabot), Murphy now has his eye on Chisum's ranch.
